about.metaTitle: About Click IT — Web Development & Digital Marketing Team
about.metaDescription: Click IT is a web studio from Kharkiv, Ukraine: 6+ years in website development, design, SEO and advertising. We help businesses win more loyal customers.
about.lead: Our mission is to help your business win more loyal customers through websites, smart promotion and a well-thought-out strategy.
about.storyTitle: A tool for solving business challenges
story: For more than 6 years we have been building websites in Kharkiv and Kyiv. Our core development team has remained practically unchanged — and our specialists’ experience is our main advantage.

Dozens of online resources we created have already helped entrepreneurs build businesses from scratch. We know a website is your investment, and we do everything to make it pay off as quickly as possible.

values.title: Experienced team
values.text: We study your requirements and business specifics in depth before implementation.

values.title: On-time delivery
values.text: We plan work in stages and agree on the result at every step.

values.title: Tailored approach
values.text: We always dig into the client’s challenge and offer the best-fit solution.

values.title: Professionalism
values.text: Stable websites with rich functionality: pages load, forms work.

about.fullCycle: We care not only about code and features but also about UI/UX design, branding and marketing. You can rely on us for everything — from design to support and promotion.

privacy.metaDescription: How Click IT web studio processes and protects personal data submitted through website forms.

sections.title: What data we collect
sections.text: Through the forms on this site we receive data you provide voluntarily: name, phone number, email and project description.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.text: The data is used solely to contact you, respond to your request and prepare a cooperation proposal.

sections.title: Sharing with third parties
sections.text: We do not sell or share your data with third parties, except for services needed to deliver your request (email service or messenger) and cases required by law.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
sections.text: With your consent the site uses Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics and Google Ads tools to analyse traffic and measure ad performance. Before consent is given these tools run without storing cookies. You can change your choice at any time via the “Cookie settings” link at the bottom of the site.

sections.title: Storage and protection
sections.text: We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect data and keep it no longer than necessary for the stated purposes.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You may request access to, correction or deletion of your data by writing to contact@click-it.com.ua.
